title: Atkin polynomials for families of abelian varieties with real multiplication
summary: Generalizing the work of Atkin and Kaneko-Zagier in the elliptic case, we describe the non-ordinary locus of a genus-zero non-compact curve $Y$ in a Hilbert modular variety in terms of the zeros of generalized Atkin's orthogonal polynomials. The argument relies on the recent construction of lifts of partial Hasse invariants for $Y$. We further describe these orthogonal polynomials as denominators of Padé approximants to the logarithmic derivatives of solutions of the Picard-Fuchs differential equations associated with $Y$.
